{{incomplete|article}} {{missing image}} [[File:Pokémon Craft DX cover.png|thumb|right|200px|Front cover of the manga that came with the Pokémon Craft DX Charizard set]] '''Pokémon Craft''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンクラフト''' ''Pokémon Craft'') is a series of paper-fold Pokemon craft sets by [[Jupiter Corporation]], itself part of their larger Magic Craft series.[https://www.jupiter.co.jp/e/product/kraft/ Official Jupiter website craft product list] Each entry came with a single-page {{pkmn|manga}} with illustrations by [[Emiko Yoshino]], an instruction sheet, and paper craft sheets for 3 Pokémon. There is also a sub-series of Pokémon Craft known as '''Pokémon Craft DX''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンクラフトDX''' ''Pokémon Craft DX''), containing a longer manga booklet, 5 paper craft sheets, and an extra such as a diorama set. They notably depict an [[List of unused Pokémon and character designs#Female character|unnamed female character]] bearing similarities to what would become [[Leaf]] and [[Green (game)|Green]]. Additional sets under the name of '''Pokémon Craft Movie Special''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンクラフト ムービースペシャル''' ''Pokémon Craft Movie Special'') were made available to promote the [[Pokémon movie]]s. For the [[Satellaview]], the December 21, 1997 issue of the downloadable magazine "Tora Maga Daisakusen" included a copy of Pokémon Craft, which included a miniature manga about how to make a paper {{p|Pikachu}}.[http://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_detailpage&v=V9xfteqo-jw#t=219 Tora Maga Daisakusen 12 21 on Youtube][https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4g4br7xjk-Q Ep. 39 - The Satellaview BS-X & Pokémon Craft by EveryGameEver] Tora Maga Daisakusen had a feature about ''Satella de Picross'' from December 1997 and people who solved all of the puzzles in it had a chance to win a copy of the Pokémon Craft Electric Set.[http://superfamicom.org/blog/2013/05/this-new-rom-dump-just-poked-my-mons/ This new ROM dump just poked my mons. | Satellablog (comment by Bluesun)] == Products == === Pokémon Craft === {|class="roundtable sortable c" width="75%" style="margin:auto; background:#{{silver color}}; border: 5px solid #{{silver color dark}}" |-style="background:#{{silver color light}}" !
